messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up: sudden WS reconnect spike in eu-west-1 at ~11:05 UTC, ~3x baseline. Any recent infra changes?
Priya Nair: Saw it on the dashboard, p95 open/close climbs. No increase in backend 5xx.
Jamal Ortiz: Logs show proxy sending 204 early-close during keepalive window, clients reconnect. example:
```
[2026-03-21T11:04:58Z] proxy=gw-21 session=sess-77 resp=204 body=empty
[2026-03-21T11:04:59Z] ws-close session=sess-77 reason=remote_close
[2026-03-21T11:05:00Z] client-reconnect session=sess-77 attempt=1
```
Marta Kowalski: We did change keepalive-ttl to 45s on low-memory nodes at 11:00 for a canary. Might be drain-induced 204s.
Alex Chen: tracer-bot pull a trace for sess-77.
tracer-bot: trace link: https://console.internal/traces/1800204321-77 (internal) -> shows proxy drain hook emitting 204 without probe-origin tag; sticky-lease still assigned.
Priya Nair: Console UX gap: many affected traces have missing probe-origin and show under "unknown" tenant row, making correlation with canary impossible.
Jamal Ortiz: Billing anomaly: some reconnects produce delayed duplicate billing events. Suspect resume path re-emit on reconnect.
Marta Kowalski: Short-term mitigation: revert keepalive-ttl on the low-memory pool. Also add proxy-drain_reason and response-code to session table.
infra-bot: deploy "revert-keepalive-ttl-lowmem" started at 11:20 UTC by Priya N.
Priya Nair: Revert completed 11:26 UTC. Reconnect rate back to baseline by 11:28. Filed INF-2001 for follow-ups.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll add resume-path idempotency check and a meter assertion to prevent double billing. PR ETA today.
Marta Kowalski: I'll draft postmortem and backlog console UX improvements (trace-link, response-code filter, probe-origin column).
Alex Chen: Follow-ups: 1) e2e test for proxy mid-ttl 204 behavior, 2) routing sim scenario for proxy drain, 3) billing unit test for resume dedupe, 4) heatmap for proxy-204 by node-id.
Priya Nair: Filed dashboard task DD-402 for heatmap and assigned to eng-sre.
Alex Chen: Great work, fast rollback. Closing loop unless anyone has more to add.
